# Fire in the Cave — Lab & Knowledge Vault

> Canonical repository of cognitive frameworks, N=1 self-discovery, and systems modeling by Fire in the Cave.

- [The Recovery that Doesn't Rehire](https://www.fireinthecave.com/shards/the-recovery-that-doesnt-rehire/): The Structural Trap
- [Start Here - The Modeler's Map](https://www.fireinthecave.com/shards/start-here-the-modelers-map/): The Pattern is the Point
- [Taking Stock in a New AI World](https://www.fireinthecave.com/shards/taking-stock-in-a-new-ai-world/): How to Maneuver
- [The AI Thread in War](https://www.fireinthecave.com/shards/the-ai-thread-in-war/): A Timeline, A Mechanism, and a Question Nobody Is Asking

- [Signal in the Silence: Why You Miss Your Own Gorilla](https://www.fireinthecave.com/shards/signal-in-the-silence-why-you-miss/): A methodology for seeing what you don't even know to look for.

- [How Silver Price Volatility Revealed What was Coming?](https://www.fireinthecave.com/shards/how-silver-price-volatility-revealed/): Why I Bought a Mac Instead of Waiting

## Lab Pages

- [Understanding Self: The Baseline](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/n-1-experiments/self): Internal drivers, somatic baseline telemetry, and N=1 inquiry into self-sovereign navigation.
- [Preparing for Blue Ocean](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/n-1-experiments/preparation): Preparing oneself, building tools and provisioning for journey into the unknown.
- [Navigating the Waters](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/n-1-experiments/sailing_open_sea): Navigating the unknown.
- [Mapping the Paths](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/n-1-experiments/mapping_journey): Mapping the paths and journaling experience.
- [N=1 Experiments](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/n-1-experiments/): Predictive mind needs data.
- [About: Systems Modeling & Ontological Sovereignty](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/about): Background in DMPK modeling, the transition to self-sovereign systems, and the N=1 methodology of Fire in the Cave.
- [Collaborations & Advisory: Data Systems & Cognitive Infrastructure](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/collaborations): Operational principles and engagement models for local AI deployment, private pipelines, and sovereign sensemaking.
